title: Squiggling Scribble Squid
statement: Darting curiously through a sunlit tangle of swaying glass-kelp and sunken brass astrolabes, this thumb-sized, translucent cephalopod ripples with shifting constellations and hasty, unreadable doodles across its skin. Whenever a visitor pauses at the tank, it hovers upside-down in greeting and puffs out a single, shimmering ring of golden ink that hangs in the water like a floating question mark.
